title: Felix and the Sigil Revisited
author: Lior Dravenmoor
blurb: Ansel Nystrom, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
